recipes.name: Field Stew
recipes.description: A hearty lunch bowl built from grain and fresh greens.
recipes.description_zh: 用谷物和新鲜蔬菜做成的扎实午餐炖碗。

night_material_synergy.feedback: A salvage garnish gave the stew a memorable hook.
night_material_synergy.feedback_zh: 一点废料风味点缀，让这锅炖菜多了个让人记住的亮点。

recipes.name: Herb Tea
recipes.description: A quick daytime pour that keeps service moving.
recipes.description_zh: 快速出杯的日间饮品，能让营业节奏维持顺畅。

recipes.name: Sweet Bread
recipes.description: A richer bakery staple once the restaurant finds its footing.
recipes.description_zh: 餐馆站稳脚跟后常驻菜单里的高价值烘焙主食。

night_material_synergy.feedback: The night-forged glaze turned heads at the counter.
night_material_synergy.feedback_zh: 夜间调出的釉层让前台顾客一眼就记住了这道甜面包。

recipes.name: Kelpfire Noodles
recipes.description: Glow Kelp turns a basic pantry into a high-demand daytime special, making even short night hauls worth plating.
recipes.description_zh: 辉光海带能把普通库存抬成高需求的日间特餐，让短途夜跑也值得上桌。

night_material_synergy.feedback: A shaved ribbon of abyssfin pushed one bowl into premium-special territory.
night_material_synergy.feedback_zh: 一缕深渊鳍鱼片，就足以把这一碗推到高价特供的档位。

recipes.name: Kelpberry Tart
recipes.description: A bright shore-market tart that turns a humble berry crop into real daytime margin.
recipes.description_zh: 带海岸集市气息的明亮甜挞，能把朴素的莓果变成真正的白天利润。

night_material_synergy.feedback: A glow-kelp glaze turned the tart into a window-draw special.
night_material_synergy.feedback_zh: 辉光海带糖衣让这份甜挞成了橱窗级招徕单品。

recipes.name: Emberleaf Flatbread
recipes.description: Peppery leaves and fresh herbs make this lunch special worth more than dumping raw produce on the stall.
recipes.description_zh: 辛香叶和新鲜香草让这道午市特餐远比原料直接摆摊更值钱。

night_material_synergy.feedback: Reef salt sharpened the emberleaf finish and sold out the hot trays.
night_material_synergy.feedback_zh: 礁盐把余烬叶的收尾风味提得更利，热盘很快就被一扫而空。

recipes.name: Mooncap Hotpot
recipes.description: A marquee hotpot that proves Moon Spores and Abyssfin can reshape the whole daytime economy.
recipes.description_zh: 一锅招牌级火锅，足以证明月孢和深渊鳍能重塑整套白天经济。

recipes.name: Abyssfin Crudo
recipes.description: Pure night-haul cuisine: scarce ingredients, minimal prep, and the best single-plate payout in the restaurant.
recipes.description_zh: 彻底的夜间渔获料理：原料稀缺、处理极简，却能带来餐馆单盘最高回报。
